newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Rising MOL, TVK push up Hungary BUX share index.
newsitem.headline: Rising MOL, TVK push up Hungary BUX share index.

text.p: Most Hungarian shares closed steady or slightly lower in Wednesday but the BUX index still rose on oil and gas company MOL MOLB.BU) and chemicals maker TVK (TVKD.BU, which firmed in brisk trading, traders said.
"The market more or less stagnated," said Peter Lencs of MKB Securities.
The BUX closed at 3,676.93 points, up 10.97 points.
"Clearly MOL and TVK pulled up the BUX as these have such large weight in the index," said Gyorgy Czipo of ING Barings.

MOL, which has risen steadily since last Thursday when the government announced energy price hikes for 1997, closed at 1,865 forints, up 30, and dealers said they did not yet see the end of the bullish trend for MOL shares.

TVK rose as large buyers appeared on the market. London-based Nomura Research published a positive update about TVK recently, but dealers said the price was more likely to have been influenced by other factors.
"TVK had a good day, but it remains to be seen if it will continue," Lencs said.

Dealers said Wednesday's rise in the BUX was moderate as the firming of the dollar did not boost the market as much as in the previous two days, while this week's rising trend appeared to have lost steam.
"Quiet days will follow," Czipo said. "I expect slight movements up and down in the near future."
